name: Vindication

categories.label: Honor on score track
categories.hint: Honor gained during play (cards, regions, monsters, speed, vindication) as shown on the scoring track, before end-game bonuses.

categories.label: Mastery tile honor
categories.hint: Sum honor printed on each Mastery tile you won (one per attribute, only for the single player with the highest total; a tie gives nobody the tile). Total = cards of that colour + proficiency tiles (2 each) + card bonuses.

categories.label: End-game bonuses on cards
categories.hint: Honor from conditional end-game bonuses printed on Monster/Trait/Relic/Companion cards.

categories.label: Secret quest honor
categories.hint: Honor for each completed quest on your secret quest card (2 optional quests, no penalty for incomplete ones).

categories.label: Regions still controlled
categories.hint: 2 honor per region you control at game end.

categories.label: End-game trigger tokens (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Token kết thúc game (phân định hòa)

endCondition.description: When an active end-game trigger card is met, finish the current round; the next round is the final round.

notes: family: area-majority (attribute-majority mastery tiles + region control). Mastery tile honor values are printed on the tiles (7 for vision per rulebook example; other values not stated in text) so the sum is entered. Expansions (Guilds & Monuments, etc.) not modelled. Solo variant not modelled.
